name: Cingciges

attributes.attribute: Irish terms for Pentecost or Whit Sunday

text: Cingciges is an Irish term for Pentecost, the church feast also called Whit Sunday, and the variant form Cingcís carries the same sense. The Latin root quinquagesima lies behind the name. Older beliefs have attached themselves to the feast, and MacKillop points readers to his entry on Whitsun customs for the seasonal practice. Like many church feasts, it drew folk observance of greater age into its place on the calendar.

okr.objective: Cingciges names Pentecost in Irish and carries older folk beliefs into the church feast.
key_results: Cingciges and the variant Cingcís are Irish terms for Pentecost or Whit Sunday.
The Latin root quinquagesima lies behind the name.
